title: Dracula, Prisoner of Frankenstein
writer: Jesús Franco, Paul D'Ales, Mary Shelley
actors: Dennis Price, Howard Vernon, Paca Gabaldón
plot: Dracula kills victims. Dr. Seward tries to stop him. Dr. Frankenstein brings Dracula back to life, using his monster. Dracula and a female vampire terrorize the town. Seward is attacked by Frankenstein's monster.
